correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs the complete independence polynomial of \(C_7\boxtimes C_7\) by a row-state transfer method and independently enumerates all target-size \(10\) codes by a branch-and-bound search in the compatibility graph. The first route gives maximum \(10\) and exactly \(980\) maxima; the second finds \(200\) maxima through \(00\), expands them by all \(49\) translations to the same \(980\), and satisfies \(980\cdot10=200\cdot49\). Applying every one of the \(392\) explicitly generated natural symmetries partitions the complete census into orbits of sizes \(392,392,196\), with stabilizers \(1,1,2\). The invariant fingerprints and coordinate profiles are checked on every maximum.

value.rationale: The \(C_7\) channel is a classical benchmark in zero-error information theory, and its two-use strong square is a natural finite extremal object. The exact count \(980\) by itself leaves the extremizers structurally opaque. The three-orbit classification shows that there are exactly two generic symmetry types and one more symmetric exceptional type, and a two-number distance fingerprint recognizes them. This is a natural complete equality classification and a compact benchmark for symmetry-aware searches in higher strong powers.
